cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM deals WHERE day >= '2023-01-01' AND day < '2024-01-01'
SELECT count(*) FROM deals WHERE day >= '2023-02-01' AND day < '2023-03-01' AND region='Navoiy viloyati' AND status='Исполнен'
SELECT count(*) FROM deals d JOIN participants p ON p.inn=d.buyer_inn WHERE day >= '2023-02-01' AND day < '2023-03-01' AND d.region='Navoiy viloyati' AND p.region<>d.region
SELECT region,count(*) n FROM deals WHERE day >= '2023-02-01' AND day < '2023-03-01' GROUP BY region ORDER BY n DESC,region LIMIT 3
SELECT buyer_broker,count(*) n FROM deals WHERE day >= '2023-02-01' AND day < '2023-03-01' GROUP BY buyer_broker ORDER BY n,buyer_broker LIMIT 3
SELECT count(*) FROM deals WHERE day >= '2023-02-01' AND day < '2023-03-01' AND (buyer_broker='BK039' OR seller_broker='BK039')

SELECT round(sum(CASE c.currency WHEN 'Доллар США' THEN d.amount*r.rate ELSE d.amount END),2)
                 FROM deals d JOIN contracts c ON c.id=d.contract_id JOIN usd_rates r ON r.day=d.day
                 WHERE d.day >= '2023-02-01' AND d.day < '2023-03-01'

SELECT round(sum(d.amount)/nullif(sum(d.quantity*d.lot),0),2) FROM deals d
                 JOIN contracts c ON c.id=d.contract_id WHERE day >= '2023-02-01' AND day < '2023-03-01' AND d.unit='тонна' AND c.currency='Узбекский сум'

WITH y AS (SELECT substr(day,1,4) yr,count(*) n FROM deals GROUP BY 1)
                 SELECT round(100.0*(b.n-a.n)/nullif(a.n,0),2) FROM y a,y b WHERE a.yr='2022' AND b.yr='2023'
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT buyer_inn FROM deals WHERE day >= '2023-02-01' AND day < '2023-03-01' GROUP BY buyer_inn HAVING count(DISTINCT seller_inn)>=3)
SELECT count(*) FROM deals WHERE day >= '2023-02-01' AND day < '2023-03-01' AND delivery_day < payment_day
